name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish supported public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery and schemas do not grant execution support. The legacy batch writer remains runtime-disabled. Dispatcher ded07x99dcxb504 is connected-read-admitted only on its reviewed tuple; future mismatches fail closed. Current readers cover calculations, editor/project metadata, PCB layers, loaded identities and bounded geometry; raw model fields are not necessarily rendered geometry or saved contents. Writing remains narrow: eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each write requires its own runtime, original ownership, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. General schematic/PCB geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. The native diagnostic workflow retains the original Windows process and Job, admits exact source/context identities and exposes fixed worker and model observations without arbitrary debugger code. Its composite model reader samples compiler state, pending producers and bounded raw String membership; it does not prove atomicity, whole-board completeness, queue completion or writer eligibility. Installed081744 qualified native launch and normal cleanup, but browser inspection failed before project opening. Corrected dispatch and subsequent observer/opening changes still require connected qualification. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate data, replay caches or automatically Save. They are not isolated or guaranteed unchanged. Ambiguous calls remain consumed; inspection, normal closure, proved process/Job termination and helper release are separate steps. Lost ownership cannot be reconstructed from journals. No implicit Save/Discard, forced termination, blind retries, arbitrary caller JavaScript or unrestricted Save is supported. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. Consult the packaged skills, exact operation contracts and per-method coverage inventory for supported subsets, evidence and remaining work.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
